title: The Dreamland balcony and glass floor
summary: Louis and the band were up high on a platform; Hunter identifies a photograph as Dreamland with its balcony and glass floor.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Now, in some of those clubs from pictures I've seen the band would be on a little balcony.
Well, that's where Louis and them were.
Up high. They were up high, up there like that. And we were down here. But they would be way up like that ceiling. Uh-huh. Big, big platform.

Yeah. I wonder -- I want to show you or rather, Lil's niece after Lil died, and there's one I have some pictures I have you gave me, and (unintelligible) have a feeling might be the Dreamland, and it has a balcony with a --
Railing. And then under the balcony they have some tables --
That's Dreamland. And they had a big glass floor.
Glass floor. Right in the middle of the floor was a big glass. It wasn't a whole glass floor, but square like this table. Yeah, now that's --
